title: At the Market: Amounts That Matter
description: Understand and use useful Czech quantities while buying everyday food.

data.heading: Buy useful amounts
data.body: Listen to the whole chunks first. The word after an amount often changes its ending; use the chunks before studying a table.

data.prompt_en: Listen once for the shopping list. Then listen again for the detail.
data.transcript_cz: Dobrý den. Prosím kilo jablek, litr mléka a trochu cukru.

questions.question_en: How much milk does the customer want?

data.prompt_en: Use the image and the message together.
data.image_label: Buying apples, milk and sugar at a Prague market
data.text_cz: Anna kupuje kilo jablek, litr mléka a trochu cukru. Večer chce udělat koláč.
data.text_en: Anna is buying a kilo of apples, a litre of milk and a little sugar. In the evening she wants to make a cake.

questions.question_en: Why is Anna buying these things?
options: She wants to make a cake

questions.question_en: Which item is measured in litres?

exercises.answer_key: She wants to make a cake

data.explanation: Keep each quantity together with the noun that follows it.

exercises.answer_key: kilo jablek–a kilo of apples; litr mléka–a litre of milk; trochu cukru–a little sugar; hodně práce–a lot of work

data.explanation: Use the complete chunk: litr mléka.
Say the whole useful chunks: kilo jablek, litr mléka.
Prosím can make a short request polite.

exercises.prompt: Listen and write the shopping list

data.expected_text: Prosím kilo jablek a trochu cukru.
data.note: Listen for each complete quantity phrase.

exercises.answer_key: Prosím kilo jablek a trochu cukru.

data.target_text: Prosím kilo jablek a litr mléka.
data.translation_en: A kilo of apples and a litre of milk, please.

exercises.answer_key: Prosím kilo jablek a litr mléka.

data.explanation: Use a short complete quantity phrase in each reply.

exercises.answer_key: Prosím kilo jablek. | Ano, litr mléka.

data.prompt_en: Write a Czech shopping list with three items. Include one kilo, one litre, or trochu.
data.sample_answer: Kilo jablek, litr mléka a trochu cukru.

exercises.answer_key: Kilo jablek, litr mléka a trochu cukru.

data.prompt_en: Record a 15–25 second market order. Ask for three things and include at least one quantity phrase.
